basic_profile.bio: I'm a 41-year-old tech enthusiast and DIY hobbyist from Portland, Oregon. I work as an IT consultant, which keeps me very busy, but I always make time for my passions like vaping, landscaping, and keeping up with the latest in mobile technology. I'm married with two kids and a Golden Retriever named Max. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and sometimes during lunch breaks. I love sharing knowledge and helping others troubleshoot tech issues.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have been working in IT for over 15 years. My fascination with technology extends into my personal life, where I spend a lot of time researching and experimenting with new gadgets and software. My interest in vaping started as a hobby, and I've since become quite knowledgeable about different devices and troubleshooting techniques.
